'''Ganelon Shipyards''' was a [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyard]] located during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] in the [[Large Scale Production Facilities]] of [[Upper Industrial Sector]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]. In [[3643 BBY]], [[Hedarr Soongh]] arranged a meeting with the [[Hunter (individual)|Hunter]] at the shipyards.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ganelon Shipyards appear in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the Imperial Agent class mission on Nar Shaddaa.
